result.description: Web data API for AI agents: search, scrape, crawl, map, extract and interact with web pages, returning clean Markdown or structured JSON.
result.auth_detail: API key (fc-...) sent as Authorization: Bearer header. OAuth for apps lets users connect their own Firecrawl account. Some scrape/search endpoints work keyless with limits.
result.access_detail: Free plan, no credit card: 1,000 credits/month, 2 concurrent requests. Paid plans (Hobby $19/mo, Standard $99/mo) for higher limits. Dashboard signup gives API key immediately.
result.api_notes: REST at https://api.firecrawl.dev (v1/v2). Endpoints: scrape, crawl, map, search, extract, batch scrape, agent, interact, parse, monitor, credit usage. Official SDKs exist. Focused on web-data, not broad object model.

evidence.quote: Firecrawl is the context API for AI agents. Search, scrape, and interact with the live web to get clean Markdown or structured data.
The header should contain `Bearer fc-123456789`, where `fc-123456789` represents your API Key.
To let users connect their own Firecrawl account to your app instead, use OAuth for apps.
Firecrawl gives you 1,000 free credits every month, which covers about 1,000 pages, and no card is required.
